problem_statement: BYOM capability experiments need a repeatable Azure resource foundation.
hypothesis: An engineer can provision the gateway, AI resource/project, and search service through notebooks without manually creating resources or copying connection values.
security_notes: Public authenticated endpoints. No service connections, API key retrieval, or policy-bypass tags. Generated environment values are ignored by Git.
setup_time_estimate: 5-10 minutes for local setup; Azure provisioning time varies, especially APIM.
